about: BN4's LifeAura D (its chip 201) against BN6's LifeAur (182), one chip under two spellings by the owner's call (docs/multirom/bn4-chips.md, call 5): the alias asked of the differential, each used at fight frame 30 against a Mettaur at (5,2), whose waves the aura takes.
subject: megaman

verdict.why: Alike through t33, the use and the aura's set-up. At t34 the aura is set, the same aura by each game's table (BN4's kind 6 and BN6's 9: 1 HP behind 200 for 3000 frames, docs/rom/bn4.md, Barriers and auras), and the collision data's HP, aura and frames agree; what parts is the kind's number (6 and 9), where MegaMan keeps the aura's object (BN4 his object's +0x50, BN6 his AI data's +0x60) and the aura's object itself, the fourth kind's type 7, whose every routine is each game's own (BN4 0x080E2418, 0x080E243C, 0x080E24A4; BN6 0x080E1E10, 0x080E1E44, 0x080E1EC8). Open: those three read into the comparator, then a hit of 200 that breaks it.
